title: Blacker Than Black
victim: Megumi Fushiguro, first-year at Tokyo Jujutsu High
teaser: On the eve of the exchange event with Kyoto Jujutsu High, the guests are spending the night in Tokyo. At 02:30 a black curtain fell over the grounds, and at 02:40 first-year Megumi Fushiguro was found in the old dojo. He was sitting against the wall with his hands joined in a summoning sign, but nothing ever came out of his shadow. Talismans were burning out around him. Gojo, who has looked after Megumi since he was a child, was far away that night.

habits.label: Talks in onigiri fillings
habits.habit: Every other word is "salmon", "tuna mayo" or "kelp"
clues: The guard at the gate heard someone mutter "salmon" in the dark by the dojo. The culprit talks in onigiri fillings.
A tuna mayo onigiri wrapper lies on the dojo steps. The culprit talks in onigiri fillings.

habits.label: Eats mochi
habits.habit: Eats strawberry mochi at any hour
clues: A mochi wrapper, still sticky, lies by the body. The culprit eats mochi.
The dojo door handle has a white smear of the starch mochi are dusted with. The culprit eats mochi.

habits.label: Sews soft toys
habits.habit: Always carries a needle and thread and sews toys
clues: A needle with pink thread is sticking out of a crack in the floor. The culprit sews soft toys.
There are tufts of toy stuffing on the tatami by the body. The culprit sews soft toys.

habits.label: Smells of incense
habits.habit: Their clothes smell of temple incense
clues: Incense is never burned in the dojo, yet in the night it smelled of it. The culprit smells of incense.
There's a pinch of grey ash from an incense stick on the dojo threshold. The culprit smells of incense.

habits.label: Black nail varnish
habits.habit: Paints their nails black and is forever touching them up
clues: There's a flake of black varnish on the edge of a burnt talisman. The culprit wears black nail varnish.
There's a scratch on the door frame, and a crumb of black varnish glints in it. The culprit wears black nail varnish.

habits.label: Collar up to the nose
habits.habit: Fastens the uniform collar right up to their nose
clues: The guard saw a figure by the dojo with only its eyes showing above the collar. The culprit hides their face in their collar.
A hook torn off a high uniform collar lies by the body. The culprit hides their face in their collar.

habits.label: Lollipop
habits.habit: Always has a lollipop in their mouth
clues: A lollipop stick, still sweet, lies under the dojo window. The culprit always has a lollipop in their mouth.
Megumi's sleeve has a sticky patch of cherry syrup. The culprit always has a lollipop in their mouth.

habits.label: Wears geta
habits.habit: Wears wooden geta even in the corridors
clues: At about 02:30 wooden soles clattered down the path to the dojo. The culprit wears geta.
The gravel by the entrance shows prints of two crosswise teeth, like from geta. The culprit wears geta.

habits.label: Feeds the crows
habits.habit: Always carries crow food in their pocket
clues: Crows were cawing on the dojo roof in the middle of the night, as if waiting for a handout. The culprit feeds the crows.
Grain and a black crow feather are scattered on the floor by the body. The culprit feeds the crows.

habits.label: Glued to their phone
habits.habit: Stays on their phone even during training
clues: At about 02:35 the blue light of a screen flickered in the dojo window. The culprit is glued to their phone.
A torn-off phone charm shaped like a little curse was found under the tatami. The culprit is glued to their phone.

habits.label: Pink hair
clues: A long pink hair is tangled in Megumi's uniform. The culprit has pink hair.
There's a spot of pink hair dye on the dojo threshold. The culprit has pink hair.

habits.label: Listens to baseball
habits.habit: Never misses a baseball broadcast and listens on the radio
clues: The watchman heard the murmur of a sports commentator coming from the dojo. The culprit listens to baseball.
A tiny earpiece on a wire from a radio was left on the windowsill. The culprit listens to baseball.

habits.label: Chews dried squid
habits.habit: Carries a bag of dried squid
clues: The whole dojo reeks of dried squid, though nobody goes in there with food. The culprit chews dried squid.
A strip of dried squid is stuck in Megumi's uniform pocket. The culprit chews dried squid.

habits.label: Wears an omamori
habits.habit: Wears an omamori temple charm on their belt
clues: A torn omamori cord lies by the entrance. The culprit wears a charm.
Among the burnt talismans there's an omamori pouch that survived. The culprit wears a charm.

habits.label: Smells of bruise balm
habits.habit: Rubs mint balm on their bruises after every training session
clues: The door handle has a greasy print that smells of mint. The culprit smells of bruise balm.
The doctor noticed a fresh tube of balm missing from the infirmary, and the empty one turned up in the dojo. The culprit smells of bruise balm.

habits.label: Shinai on the back
habits.habit: Carries a bamboo sword in a case on their back
clues: The ceiling beam by the entrance has a fresh scratch, like from the end of a shinai carried on someone's back. The culprit carries a shinai.
The leather tip of a bamboo sword lies by the body. The culprit carries a shinai.

strong: The heavy dojo door, which two students can barely move, was slid shut from inside with one hand: it bears the print of a single palm. The culprit is physically strong.
The rack of wooden swords was ripped out of the wall, brackets and all, and thrown across the entrance. The culprit is physically strong.
quiet: The school barrier registers any outside energy on the grounds, but at 02:30 it registered nobody on the way to the dojo. The culprit can conceal their cursed energy.
Megumi began forming the summoning sign but didn't finish it: he noticed the killer too late. The culprit can conceal their cursed energy.
tools: The body has no trace of anyone's technique: the blow was dealt with a cursed tool. The culprit knows how to handle cursed tools.
A case wrapped in sealed cloth was found by the door. That's how a tool's energy is hidden so it can't be sensed. The culprit knows how to handle cursed tools.
medic: There's hardly any blood on the floor: the wound was closed at once with reverse cursed technique so curses wouldn't smell the blood. The culprit knows medicine.
The body was packed with ice from the infirmary to make the time of death seem later. The culprit knows medicine.
keys: The principal locks the old dojo at night, but at 02:15 the door was opened with a key, not by force. The culprit had a key.
The cabinet of spare talismans in the staff room is locked, yet a bundle is missing from it. The culprit had a key.
safe: The curtain was lowered by the book, with the full incantation and an anchor at the main gate. Not everyone is taught that. The culprit knows barrier incantations.
The ring of talismans round the body was a small barrier that muffles sound. The culprit knows barrier incantations.
sched: Every night at half past two Megumi practises summoning in the old dojo while nobody's there. Only people at the school know about it. The culprit knows the school routine.
The guard at the gate changes at 02:30, and for a few minutes nobody is there. That's exactly when the curtain fell. The culprit knows the school routine.
tech: The alarm on the dojo door was switched off from the panel in the staff room, not torn out. The culprit knows their way around machinery.

At 02:20 Megumi got a message from Gojo's number: "Waiting in the old dojo", though Gojo was on a mission that night and never touched his phone. The number was spoofed. The culprit knows their way around machinery.
cash: A week ago someone anonymously paid for a fake call-out so that Gojo would leave on a mission and be away from the school tonight. It's a sum you couldn't scrape together from a student grant. The culprit has serious money.
That night the watchman was replaced by a stranger nobody at the school had hired. He was paid a month's wages in cash for a single shift. The culprit has serious money.
passages: Master Tengen shuffles the school's doors every night, yet the killer got out through the right one first time. The culprit knows the school's secret ways.
A path through the grove that isn't on any map of the grounds leads from the shrine to the dojo. The culprit knows the school's secret ways.
